about: Whether a GENERAL that a CUSTOMER PIP customization disables still makes a simplified policy's condition one the tenant holds. The condition sits in a simplified policy: a set that reads a disabled PIP fails every check by itself (r29structure-cpip-disable), a simplified policy is not known to.

cases.about: Control: a simplified policy for READ whose condition holds. True unless the stand answers every check with 400. The next case replaces it in the domain.

A simplified policy for READ with condition resource.a == 'y' OR subject.parityR41HeldPipDisable == 'v'; the domain declares that GENERAL with a whole ${subject.isM2M} in requestAttributes. read-a-y answers 400: the tenant holds the condition.

A set that never names the GENERAL, under which a check is true; the case declares no PIP, so the domain keeps the simplified policy before it. before-* answer 400, the tenant holding the simplified policy's condition. A CUSTOMER PIP customization then disables subject.parityR41HeldPipDisable. after-read answers true if the tenant reads the declarations the PIP customizations make and a simplified policy that reads an undeclared PIP fails nothing; 400 if the tenant still reads the uploaded declaration, if the disabled declaration stays with status INACTIVE, or if such a simplified policy fails every check as such a set does. after-read-policy asks the simplified policy's own type with a = y. The runner deletes the customization before the last control, which answers 400 under every reading.
Control: a DENY rule over a resource attribute that does not hold. True unless the stand answers every check with 400.
